title: Broadcasting Services Amendment (Material of Local Significance) Bill 2013

summary.attribution: Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
sentences: The bill would extend regional television local content rules to regional South Australia by adding it to the areas covered under federal broadcasting legislation.
Broadcasters covered by the change would have to meet conditions for local programming and material of local significance set by the Australian Communications and Media Authority.
The proposal would use the existing framework for regional aggregated commercial television licences, with the amendment taking effect the day after Royal Assent.
changes: Regional South Australia would be added to the statutory list of covered areas.
Affected broadcasters would come within the regulator’s existing local content conditions.
The geographic extension would begin on the day following Royal Assent.
summary.affected: Regional South Australian commercial television broadcasters and their local audiences are affected.
